question: Which products have the highest ratio of returned units in 2022 to ordered units in 2022?

data.sql: WITH ordered_units AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS ordered_units FROM commerce.order_items AS oi INNER JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 GROUP BY oi.product_id), returned_units AS (SELECT r.product_id, SUM(r.return_quantity) AS returned_units FROM commerce.returns AS r WHERE r.return_date >= $1 AND r.return_date < $2 GROUP BY r.product_id) SELECT ou.product_id, ru.returned_units, ou.ordered_units, CAST(ru.returned_units AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(ou.ordered_units, 0) AS return_ratio FROM ordered_units AS ou INNER JOIN returned_units AS ru ON ou.product_id = ru.product_id ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST, 1 LIMIT 200

metadata.explanation: Calculates the ratio of returned units to ordered units for each product in 2022. It independently aggregates order quantities from order_items (joined with orders for date filtering) and return quantities from returns, then joins these aggregates on product_id to compute the ratio. Results are ordered by the ratio in descending order, with product_id as a tie-breaker.

data.sql: WITH inv_agg AS (SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(i.units_sold) AS inventory_units_sold FROM commerce.inventory AS i INNER JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date >= $1 AND i.snapshot_date < $2 GROUP BY p.category), ord_agg AS (SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS ordered_quantity FROM commerce.order_items AS oi INNER JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN commerce.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= $3 AND o.order_date < $4 GROUP BY p.category) SELECT COALESCE(inv_agg.category, ord_agg.category) AS category, inv_agg.inventory_units_sold, ord_agg.ordered_quantity FROM inv_agg FULL JOIN ord_agg ON inv_agg.category = ord_agg.category ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
